heading: Thursday, May 22, 2025
topLine: Anthropic launches Claude Opus 4 and Claude Sonnet 4.

items.headline: Anthropic launches Claude Opus 4 and Claude Sonnet 4
items.summary: The Claude 4 generation pairs Opus 4 ($15/$75 per million tokens) with Sonnet 4 ($3/$15); both are hybrid models that can use tools during extended thinking. Anthropic reports SWE-bench Verified scores of 72.5% (Opus 4) and 72.7% (Sonnet 4), and made Claude Code generally available the same day.
